title: Cart
pendingDescription: The connection dropped while sending your order. Check its status before ordering again so it isn't placed twice.
linkedDescription: Saving updates the shared draft; placing the order uses it up.
noVendorDescription: Your cart belongs to a connected vendor. Once a vendor is connected, you can order here.
emptyDescription: Add products from the catalogue, or open a saved draft.
unavailable: {count, plural, one {One product is no longer available. Remove it to continue.} other {{countText} products are no longer available. Remove them to continue.}}
draftSaved: Saved as a draft your team can see
clearDescription: All products are removed from this cart. This can't be undone.
clearLinkedDescription: All products are removed from this cart. The saved draft stays as it was last saved.
pricingNote: Current prices excluding VAT — an estimate. The exact total is confirmed when you review the order. Payment is arranged with the vendor.
conflictDescription: Someone on your team changed, submitted or discarded this draft since you opened it. Your cart is kept. Choose what to do.
keepMineAsNew: Keep mine as a new draft
latestLoaded: Latest version of the draft loaded
draftGoneUnlinked: That draft is no longer open. Your cart is kept as new work.
